title: Senate Hearings Analysis
text: For this project we built a package that helps when webscraping Senate Hearing data from https://www.govinfo.gov/browse/committee. We have included in this website the full documentation to allow for the recreation of our project using this package along with a written report of our findings and a tutorial to show how our package is meant to be used.
